items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: Well, at that time there was Willie Wilson, Johnny Wilson, myself, Connish, Flowers, Flowers.

ctx.x: Uncle? No, we used to know him. You did know him, of course, down in the country. Yeah, I know him so long. I know him, I understand, first. I didn't know him. I think he's teacher. But sometimes he would get to talk. I said, partner, I said, you are learning good how to talk. I said, just keep on using it.

You see, getting back now to that Eureka band there. Oh, yeah. See, way back, say, about as far as I can remember, Connish had come to get me to play with the Eureka band. Well, Connish, he was no kind of reader, which Sonny knew that. But he always wanted somebody that, you know, would help him out. So he come and he got me to play one job. After he got me to play one job, well he did just like I did Sonny. Well then he say, you stay here. I said, all right, so I'll continue playing with him. So after I got to…
His father had been... Well I don't know his father.
